attempts.summary: Configured node1 (10.100.177.10) as the cluster's internal chrony time source (local stratum 10, allow 10.100.177.0/24, firewalld ntp service opened) and node2 (10.100.177.11) to sync exclusively against node1 (single `server 10.100.177.10 iburst` line, public pool servers removed). Verified node2 selects node1 as its chosen source (Reference ID 0A64B10A). Completed mandatory sequential restart protocol on both nodes: captured pre-restart boot IDs and healthy chrony state, restarted one node at a time, confirmed changed boot IDs post-restart, and verified chronyd/config/sync recovered on each before proceeding to the next.
